6.long_description:
Are you getting the most out of your Arcooda machine this Christmas? If you have one of our Highway I/O boards (included in Arcooda machines) make sure you have the latest firmware update! to enjoy home console and Android game play.

If your machine is not registered, you can register your Arcooda machine at: https://www.highwaygaming.com/

Arcooda machines support PS3 & PS4, Xbox 360 & Xbox One, Nintendo Switch, PC and Android motherboards. As new consoles are released, Arcooda offers free firmware upgrades to keep your machine up to date.

Current firmware version is 2.0
